description: Información sobre las obras de defensa realizadas para reducir el efecto de las aludes is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by icgc.cat. Inventory of defence structures built to reduce the risk of avalanches. Single and lineal structures are documented, such as artificial avalanche release systems, road barriers, breakers, deflection structures, retention nets, screens, wind baffles, deflectors, rigid and flexible barriers, retention walls, reforestation and controlled areas. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Information regarding the defence structures built to reduce the effect of avalanches" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Geologia, Pirineus, Allau, IGC Allaus, Risc natural, Seguretat. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
